label: verify-q1-theory-lean

claims.claim: Any weakly monotone single-index model h_p(a(e)) has no strict rank reversal; one strict reversal refutes the class incl. multiplicative, log-additive, thermodynamic models.
claims.source_says: theorem no_reversal_of_monotone {f} (hf : SingleIndexMono f) : ¬ HasReversal f ; theorem certificate_all (hr : RankReversal f p q e e') : ¬ Mult f ∧ ¬ SingleIndexMono f ∧ ¬ SingleIndexStrict f ∧ ¬ LogAdd f ∧ ¬ Thermo f
claims.note: Statements match the claim in plain words; Mult needs b>0, LogAdd and Thermo (a>=0, V,K>0) are proved as special cases, and the proofs read as sound.

claims.claim: A reversal does not uniquely identify mechanism: non-monotone single-index, negative promoter factor, or two-feature promoter-specific weights also reverse ranks; general interaction class is vacuous.
claims.source_says: h p x = x*(4-x) for q gives RankReversal; mult_needs_positive_b with b=1,-1; twoFactor_reverses; theorem general_is_vacuous (f) : General f := ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, f, ...⟩
claims.note: All four theorems exist and say what is claimed; the examples are concrete and the vacuity proof is trivial (c = f).
